notes.title: Version 1225.1135
notes.notes:
[u]Daily Quest Update[/u]
The Daily Quest encounters offer a difficulty option and the ability to purchase mercenaries upon entering. Difficulty can make the encounter easier or harder and the experience, drops, NPCs are scaled down or up depending on the setting.

[u]Vladimir's Franchise[/u]
Vladimir sold it to his children, who franchised the business. You can purchase mercenaries that are matched to your level in any town with a seeker. They will stay with you until they die. They take a small % of gold from your adventuring but can make a big difference in your success.	
[u]
Level Cap Raised[/u]
The level cap has been raised. The hard cap is now 200. Initially, a soft cap of 120 is being enforced to allow for some balancing. Starting at level 105, one additional orb is granted for every 10 levels.	

[u]Tamed Followers[/u]
Leadership is gained per day and the tamed followers will level up over time as you adventure with them if you can keep them alive.	

[u]Weapon Rebalance / Equal Weapon Rights[/u]
All melee weapons are now viable from a DPS standpoint. Melee weapons such as a sword, an axe, vs a mace, etc.. should all be comparable to damage ranges at levels. This will allow personal preference to factor into which weapon you choose to arm. Additionally, ranged weapons received a significant boost (along with DPS consistency at level ranges), making them much more enjoyable and viable for leveling and high-level encounters. This change applies to all static weapons and all Fabrial Weapons.

notes.title: Dransik 2.0 Release Notice
notes.notes:
This is the third of 3 announcements around [b]Friday, the 9th Launch[/b]. This announcement is focused on overall content and experienced player gameplay. 

The desert east of D'Golar has unearthed an ancient inverted tower. Tower Inversa is an end-level dungeon with a unique gate system that will throw the players into chaos. Beware! Those who enter won’t enter at the same level of the tower, and once you are in the tower, you will be between the realm of Dransik and Chaos. This dungeon comes with new monsters, resources, new items to craft, and possibly an Ancient Artifact. The boss in this dungeon can drop items from Anubis, Muknal, and Orcus at a decreased chance.

We are moving forward with designing the lands of Dransik to be more friendly to new players and spreading the hunting zones for end-level content. We needed to move a few locations of entrances for hunting spots. 
Removing Hell Cave Entrance from NK and moving to South of Garnea.

notes.title: Dransik 2.0 Release Notice
notes.notes:
This is the second of 3 announcements around [b]Friday, the 9th Launch[/b]. This announcement is focused on the client piece. 

One of the first targets for content has been to clean up Silvest and work on the new player experience. The new client is a huge step in improving the first impressions and adding much-needed information to the character creation process and overall ease of use in scalability, remapping keys, and more detailed interface windows.

Silvest was already in a good place - full of memorable quests, well-designed encounters, and challenging danger areas. In addition, the outer loop of the island was removed to focus players on the main attractions of the island. The tradeskills will require more attention to present a cohesive tradeskill progression, so are largely untouched, though some bugs were fixed related to crafting as well.

notes.title: Dransik 2.0 Release Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, Dransik fans, longtime players, and new community members. Dransik began to see light around 1996 and was actively developed until 2002. The game has been kept running most of that time but not actively worked on. Friday, December 9th, that changes. 

[i]Iron Will Games[/i] will launch the first major set of changes for Dransik that targets every aspect of the game. The [u]technology[/u], the game [u]content[/u], the overall progression, and the game [u]design[/u] will all be getting a major update.

The initial release, slated for [u][b]December 9th[/b][/u], will provide a brand new and completely rewritten game client. Dransik now runs on multiple operating systems (OSX and Windows for now) with modern UI controls and support for today's larger monitors. The screen can be utilized to see the glorious Dransik pixel art much better and have room for in-game UI elements to be positioned where you want them.

In addition, the starting island of [b]Silvest[/b] has been cleaned up and refined to provide a more focused experience. Our goal here - and eventually for the rest of the game - is to ensure the quests and progression is balanced to allow those new to Dransik to have time to understand the game mechanics a bit better and gain levels in core skills so they are better equipped for venturing to the main lands.

For those who are familiar with Dransik, many bugs have been addressed in this release. Seriously, a freaking ton! There are [b]new items[/b] that can be crafted, and [b]hunting areas[/b] have been updated and added along with new [b]item drops[/b]. This is the first pass, with many more to follow, in creating more opportunities to craft, explore, hunt, specialize and style your play.

We will be releasing a more detailed description of the changes in each of these major areas over the next week. Once this release is out and stable, we will be providing announcements on the next set of major additions to the game and content.
